# Wake Up Samurai

Wake Up Samurai dresses the workspace as a Night City HUD, with an oxblood-to-charcoal gradient, red body text, cyan and green headings, gold tags and angular techno type. Its recorded description lists softly glowing panes, tinted blurred sidebars, six distinct heading levels, notched blockquote data-shards, bordered transclusion panels, a full coloured callout set, embedded Teko, Rajdhani and Electrolize fonts, and themed code blocks, tables and tags.

![Wake Up Samurai screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/cmdurham/wake_up_samurai/HEAD/wake-up-samurai.png)
